title: The bird in the Legacy
logline: The bird on the Legacy's dashboard at a stoplight in Newport, October, looking out the windshield with the driver. The driver not drawn. The only stoplight in the sequence.

panels.composition: A station wagon's dashboard from the passenger seat: the small rainbow bird standing on it looking out the windshield at a red stoplight in a wet town, the driver's hands on the wheel at the frame's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small rainbow bird standing on an old station wagon's dashboard looking through the windshield at a red stoplight in a wet town, a driver's hands on the wheel at the frame's edge, no words
